name: Waterwalking
effect_text: Water never slows you, and the first water hex you cross each turn costs no move.

name: Tidal Guard
effect_text: You and your allies standing in water get +15 glance chance per water level (15/30/45).

name: Current Push
effect_text: Attacking from water: +8/+16/+24% damage (water 1/2/3), and +5% per water hex you entered this turn (up to +20%). Your hit on a foe standing in water pushes it 1 along the water.

name: Undertow
effect_text: While you live and any water 3 is on the board, foes get +1 move toward the nearest water 3, normal move level with it and -1 move away from it.

name: Heat Rush
effect_text: No fire crossing damage, and the first fire hex you enter each turn gives +1 move. You and allies starting a turn on fire get +1 move per fire level.

name: Ember Skin
effect_text: An adjacent foe that hits you while you stand on fire takes 2/4/6% (your fire 1/2/3). Your fire standing damage is halved.

name: Kindling
effect_text: +6/+12/+18% damage when you or the target stands on fire (the higher level counts). Standing on fire, your attacks ignore 5% of the target's DEF per fire level.

name: Wildfire
effect_text: Your fresh fire at 2+ seeds fire 1 onto neutral neighbours on the next tick, once per cast; your eruption rings do too. Grass containment still applies.

name: Skate
effect_text: Ice costs you 1 move (even on mud) and never slides you: you can stop on the first ice hex you enter, or walk on. +1 move when you start your turn on one.

name: Rime Armour
effect_text: You and your allies standing on your glaze take 5% less damage per glaze level and no slam damage. Shatter doesn't apply to you.

name: Fault Lines
effect_text: Your Shatter is doubled: hits on glaze +30% (base +15%), and thunder shattering your glaze x2 (base x1.5). Slams you cause deal +8%.

name: Frostbite
effect_text: Glazing a foe's hex Pins it, and a foe starting its turn on your glaze is Drenched. A foe that slams into your pillar is Pinned.

name: Bolt Step
effect_text: After any action that detonates a tile: move 2 more.

name: Lightning Rod
effect_text: An arc that would hit an ally within 3 of you hits you instead. Chain arcs and detonation splash on you deal half.

name: Overcharge
effect_text: An arc from a target you hit jumps again: a second arc at 50% of the first, to the next-nearest of that team. Your detonations deal +5% per charge point they blow.

name: Static Field
effect_text: Your fuses last 5 cycles (base 3) and your allies' paint can't set them off. A foe ending its move on one is Staggered.

name: Tailwind
effect_text: +2 move when you start on a gale marker, and 1 more after any wind action. Allies starting their turn within 2 of you get +1 move. Updraft: +1 jump, and allies starting their turn on your gale markers get +1 jump.

name: Eye of the Storm
effect_text: Immune to displacement. Bow, pistol and thrown attacks on you can't crit.

name: Gale Force
effect_text: +5% damage per hex you moved this turn (up to +20%). After moving 4+, your first hit that turn applies your wind mode. A foe your wind skill hits is pushed 1; if something stops it, it slams.

name: Crosswind
effect_text: Your wind slams deal 12% (base 8%), and a foe you slam with wind is Becalmed.

name: Shadowstep
effect_text: Once per turn, from a dark hex, step to another dark hex within 3 that you can see, for 1 move.

name: Nightborn
effect_text: No dark drain on you. While you stand on dark, the first elemental effect each turn that would land on you is negated; so is an adjacent ally's on dark.

name: Ambush
effect_text: Attacking from dark 1/2/3: +6/+12/+18 crit, and +0.1 crit multiplier per dark level.

name: Pall
effect_text: A foe you hit while it stands on dark 2+ is Blinded (it can't crit).

name: Sunpath
effect_text: +1 move when you start on light; +2 on light 3. Allies on your beam start their turn with +1 move.

name: Judgement
effect_text: Your attacks on a foe standing on light can't glance. Allies (you too) starting their turn on your light get +5 crit per light level that turn.

name: Glare
effect_text: A foe starting its turn on light you laid isn't healed; on light 2+ it's also Blinded.

name: Sanctuary
effect_text: Your light heals allies 5/9/14% (base 3/6/9), and light's hit bonus spares you and allies on it. Once per battle, when an ally within 3 drops under 35% HP, its hex gains light 2.
